definitions.explanation: The largest living bird, native to Africa. It cannot fly but runs very fast, and lays the largest eggs of any bird.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動物園|どうぶつえん}→動物園：01686_doubutsuen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ダチョウ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{大|おお}きかった→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: I saw an ostrich egg at the zoo. It was huge.

examples.japanese: ダチョウ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時速|じそく}→時速：00128_jisoku⟧{六十|ろくじゅっ}⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Ostriches are said to be able to run at more than sixty kilometers an hour.

notes:
Usually written in katakana, like most animal names; the kanji spelling {駝鳥|だちょう} appears in older or literary writing.
